note: Shared glossary for every part of Virgil's Aeneid. Entries keyed by word form as printed in Greenough (Boston: Ginn & Company, 1881), lowercased, exactly as the reader's word splitter cuts it (enclitic -que/-ne/-ve stay on the word). Lemma — meaning (grammatical info); the lemma may carry macrons for vowel length, the text never does.

glossary.volvere: volvō, volvere, volvī, volūtum — to roll, turn; to pass through, undergo (pres. inf.)
glossary.volvit: volvō, volvere, volvī, volūtum — to roll, roll along (3rd sg. pres.)
glossary.volvitur: volvō, volvere, volvī, volūtum — to roll, tumble (3rd sg. pres. pass.)
glossary.volvunt: volvō, volvere, volvī, volūtum — to roll, turn (3rd pl. pres.)
glossary.vorat: vorō, -āre — to swallow, devour (3rd sg. pres.)
glossary.vortex: vortex (vertex), vorticis (m.) — whirlpool, eddy (nom. sg.; older spelling)
glossary.vos: tū, vōs — you (2nd pers. pl. pron.) (nom./acc. pl.)
glossary.zephyrumque: Zephyrus, -ī (m.) — Zephyr, the west wind (acc. sg.) + -que 'and'
